summary.en: Two Philippine Coast Guard bomb experts were wounded in an accidental explosion at their Zamboanga City barracks, while two Coast Guard personnel were killed in a shooting in Cotabato City. The Philippines, United States and Japan completed their 22nd multilateral maritime cooperative activity in the West Philippine Sea, and the Philippine Coast Guard rescued 20 people off Basilan. Taiwan offered cooperation to protect undersea cables and a former NSA urged activation of the Philippines-China coast guard agreement. Chinese militia boats are expanding battlefield preparation in the western Pacific, and there were 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: To bombeksperter fra den filippinske kystvakten ble såret i en utilsiktet eksplosjon på deres barakk i Zamboanga City, mens to kystvaktsoldater ble drept i en skyting i Cotabato City. Filippinene, USA og Japan fullførte sin 22. multilaterale maritime samarbeidsaktivitet i Vestfilippinene, og den filippinske kystvakten reddet 20 personer utenfor Basilan. Taiwan tilbød samarbeid for å beskytte undersjøiske kabler, og en tidligere NSA oppfordret til aktivering av avtalen mellom Filippinene og Kina om kystvakten. Kinesiske militsbåter utvider forberedelser til kamp i det vestlige Stillehavet, og det var 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
